name: seller.listing.publishFromDraft
title: Profile: seller.listing.publishFromDraft
description: Canonical profile for publishing a public listing from a completed draft.
text:
# seller.listing.publishFromDraft

TL;DR:
- This is the publish step that creates the public listing.
- Required publish fields must be complete and at least one upload id must be present.

This profile is for turning a draft into a public listing.
whenToUse: The draft is complete enough to publish.
The seller is ready to create the public listing.
recommended: Pass draftId when the listing comes from a draft so the draft gets marked as used.
Use category and location ids resolved earlier in the workflow.
avoid: Do not publish without at least one upload id.
Do not assume optional fields become magically filled from the draft unless you actually send them when required by the publish step.
exampleInterpretation: A successful response means the public listing already exists and the draft is no longer only a draft artifact.
